description: Explicit manual-development counterfactual for Wave 1. Every measured bucket is assigned exactly one category. Conservative principle: where a classification is debatable, choose the category that understates HAMR's benefit, and say so.

categories.common_both_paths: Authored in both counterfactuals; displayed for both paths and excluded from HAMR-saving claims.
categories.hamr_path_authored: Authored by the developer/agent on the HAMR path.
categories.hamr_generated_manual_replacement: HAMR-generated; forms the modeled manual-equivalent replacement value.
categories.manual_only_unmodeled: Effort the manual path would need that we deliberately do not model.
categories.unknown_provenance: Origin unresolved (no template baseline); counted in neither headline story, displayed honestly.

assignment_rules.note: Category is derived from provenance first, then artifact_type for developer-authored buckets. overwrittenIfExists:false sets generation_mode only, never provenance.
fixed_decisions: SysMLv2 models are required in both counterfactuals (John, 2026-08-10): model-authoring effort is common_both_paths and never a HAMR code-generation saving.
GUMBO contracts default to hamr_path_authored with manual-side specification effort left unmodeled (conservative; config knob, see plan section 13.4).
bin/build.cmd is skill-generated in agentic runs; it stays hamr_path_authored but is called out separately and modeled as a fixed setup activity.

manual_only_unmodeled: Manual-path behavioral specification and verification effort in place of GUMBO contracts and Verus proofs
Manual-path test-harness construction and test authoring for hand-built infrastructure
Manual acquisition of seL4/Microkit platform expertise (protection domains, channels, static schedules)
Manual integration debugging of hand-written IPC/shared-memory plumbing
Manual maintenance of consistency between architecture documentation and code

exclusions.reason: dependency lock file, tool-generated build output
codegen attestation evidence, not development work product

process/audit documentation; excluded from effort modeling (conservative: understates authored work)
experiment meta-artifacts (transcripts, metrics, assessments), not system development work
change-request sketches; empty in greenfield subjects
